tools.name: PearAI
tools.description: PearAI is an open-source, AI-powered code editor based on Visual Studio Code that combines top AI coding tools like GPT-4, Claude, LLaMA, and AI agents into one intelligent workspace. Designed for developers who want deep codebase understanding, automated assistance, and fast project scaffolding, PearAI delivers a unified, local-first AI coding experience.
bullets: Supports multiple AI coding tools in one interface for enhanced productivity.
Open-source, allowing customization and extensibility for developers.

tools.name: PyCharm AI
tools.description: PyCharm is a powerful integrated development environment (IDE) specifically designed for Python development by JetBrains. It offers intelligent code assistance, smart debugging, code refactoring, and a seamless development experience for professionals working on Python, Django, data science, and web development projects.
bullets: Tailored for Python development with advanced refactoring and debugging tools.
Built-in support for AI-powered extensions enhances coding efficiency.

tools.name: Zed
tools.description: Zed is a high-performance, open-source code editor built for speed and collaboration. It combines lightning-fast responsiveness with built-in real-time collaboration and AI-assisted code editing, redefining editor precision and coding velocity.
bullets: Offers real-time collaboration and AI-assisted code editing features.
Fast performance optimized for large codebases and instant loading.

tools.name: JetBrains IDEs
tools.description: JetBrains IDEs are a suite of professional, language-specific integrated development environments (IDEs) backed by robust coding assistance, smart refactoring, debugging, testing, and AI-powered plugin support across multiple languages.
bullets: Support for multiple languages with rich AI-powered enhancements.
Integrated refactoring and debugging tools for a streamlined development process.

tools.name: OpenAI Codex mini Latest
tools.description: Codex mini is OpenAI’s lightweight, high-speed AI coding model, enabling efficient code generation, debugging, and editing tasks, designed specifically for command-line interactions.
bullets: Lightweight AI coding model optimized for terminal workflows.
Fast performance suitable for real-time coding assistance.

tools.name: GitWit
tools.description: Gitwit is an open-source, browser-based AI coding platform that combines in-browser development with AI-powered autocomplete, instant deployment, and community collaboration.
bullets: Real-time AI assistance within a collaborative browser environment.
Free and open-source, promoting community contributions.

tools.name: Cline - Claude Dev
tools.description: Cline is an open-source AI coding agent for VS Code that automates tasks via natural language instructions, such as file creation and debugging.
bullets: Automates complex tasks in VS Code using natural language commands.
Open-source with a focus on transparency and community enhancements.

tools.name: Amazon CodeWhisperer
tools.description: Amazon CodeWhisperer is an AI-powered coding companion developed by AWS that helps developers write code faster and more securely.
bullets: Real-time code suggestions and security scans for various languages.
Deep integration with AWS services providing context-aware suggestions.

tools.name: Aider
tools.description: Aider.ai is an open-source AI-powered coding assistant that allows developers to collaborate with large language models directly from the command line.
bullets: Enhances terminal workflows with AI collaboration features.
Fully open-source with customizable functionalities.
